description: The far corner of a 2x2 of `-XX:hashCode=3` and strong chunked uniques, alone: 6 forks, judged on fork-to-fork CV of instructions/op against prior runs (`m4-forkvar-hash` hc3 0.17%, base 0.52%; `m4-forkvar-gc` fixyoung 0.24%, Xbatch+fixyoung 0.02% over 3 forks).
